title: How to Deploy a Web3 AI Agent on Avalanche ERC-8004
description:
AI agents are taking over Web3 right now. In this video, I break down exactly what an AI Agent is and show you step-by-step how to deploy a live AI Agent Identity on the Avalanche blockchain using the new ERC-8004 standard. No human approval needed, just code.

Whether you are a Web3 developer or just getting started with smart contracts, this tutorial will get you deploying on the Avalanche Fuji Testnet in minutes.

⏳ Timestamps:
Concepts & Architecture
[00:02] Introduction: Deploying an AI Agent on Avalanche
[00:25] What Actually is an AI Agent?
[00:48] Real-World Examples of AI Agents in Web3
[01:32] The Massive Unsolved Problem with AI Agents
[02:44] How the ERC-8004 Standard Solves the Trust Issue
[04:30] Understanding ERC-8004 Architecture (The 3 Registries)
[06:04] Why Build on Avalanche?
[06:30] Overview of the Contracts We Are Deploying

Technical Walkthrough
[06:56] Step 1: Setting Up VS Code & Terminal
[07:23] Step 2: Cloning the Repo & Installing Dependencies
[08:18] Step 3: Setting Up Your Environment (.env) & Core Wallet
[08:46] Step 4: Getting Fuji Testnet Tokens from the Faucet
[09:34] Step 5: Deploying the AI Agent Smart Contract

[10:02] Verifying the Contract on the Avalanche Fuji Explorer

🔗 Resources & Links:

Avalanche Fuji Testnet Explorer: https://testnet.snowtrace.io/
Avalanche  ERC-8004 boilerplate : https://github.com/ava-labs/8004-boilerplate


📫 Connect with Me:

Twitter/X: https://x.com/LakshDilliwal

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/lakshdilliwal/

⚠️ DISCLAIMER:
This video is strictly for educational and developer demonstration purposes only. It does not constitute financial, investment, or legal advice. All coding demonstrations are performed on a test network (Avalanche Fuji) using test tokens that have zero real-world monetary value. This is not a promotional video and does not endorse or encourage the buying, selling, or trading of any cryptocurrencies, tokens, or digital assets. Always conduct your own research and comply with local regulations.

asr.full_text: Hey everyone welcome I am Laksh. In this video we are doing something really interesting, we are deploying a live AI agent identity on avalanche blockchain using new standard called ERC-8004. For this no coding needed just follow along by the end of this video will have a real smart contracts live on chain. But first let me quickly explain what an AI agent actually is. So, an AI agent is a software that thinks, decides and acts completely on its own. No one gives it instructions in real-time. No approvals. It just runs using AI like Chat GPT to understand tasks, make decisions and execute them automatically And in crypto these agents are doing something serious. They're handling real money, trading tokens, managing DEFI positions all without any human in the loop. And here are four real examples working right now. A trading bot that watches the market and moves the real funds when the moment conditions are right, a dfy manager that finds the best yields across protocols and deposits your money automatically, a tax executor that picks up work on chain then completes it and gets paid without anyone touching it and a portfolio manager that rebalance your holdings with zero human input. Real money,实金 is happening right now but every single one of these agents has a one massive unsolved problems. Why can't these agents run on company servers? Let me show you the difference. On a regular server the developers control everything. They can quietly change the code, delete transaction history, hide what the bot actually did and there's zero transparency. But on the blockchain, every action is public, every transaction is permanent and nothing can be secretly changed or deleted So instead trusting the developer, you trust the chain and that changes everything because the public chain does not lie Here's why this matter right now Billions of dollars going to flow through ai agents in the next 2 years and honestly it's already starting. without any verification system you are trusting an autonomous bot with your money. If something goes wrong and if it misbehaves or takes more than it should, you have no way to prove it and no way to recover anything. ERC 8004 is the first surrender ever built to fix this it makes the agent verifiable, accountabl and trust worthy and directly on chain And today we are deploying it So what are you going to learn today? How to deploy a verifiable AI agent from scratch and How on-chain identity works, so, your agent gets a permanent digital passport And how reputation tracking works, every action recorded forever nobody can delete And how cryptographic validation works third parties can post mathematical proof that your AI agent actually behaves correctly. Five Steps, No Complexity. AI agents are moving real money right now. No human, no approval just code. Making financial decisions with real stakes, and the question nobody asks enough is, can you actually trust them? Right now, NO. Three reasons why, no identity, anyone can fake an agency, no track record, you can't check agent history and no proof of behavior. Did it actually do what it promised? When the real money is moving, trust is not enough This is exactly what ERC 8004 solves. It gives every AI agent 3 things it never had before • Verifiable identity so you know that agent is real • A public track record so everything it's ever done is visible to anyone • On-chain proof so its behavior isn't promised, it actually is verified. Let me show you how ERC8004 architecture works. ERC8004 uses three smart contracts called registries that work together to form one complete trust layer. The Identity Registry is basically a blockchain passport for your agent. It gets a unique permanent ID on chain that can't be faked and every action it takes is signed with that ID. The Reputation Registry records every tax, every payment and every client rating stored on chain forever. and every client rating stalled on-chain forever so nobody can delete the bad history and nobody can manufacture fake good history, the chain just keeps score. The validation registry is where third party auditors post cryptographic proof, actual mathematical verification that your agent was tested and works correctly. Not a document, real verifiable proof. Together, its a complete trust layer for any AI agent. Here's the part that makes this really powerful. Every Action your agent takes on change generates a unique transaction hash. A permanent public record. That means anyone can search your Agent address of the blockchain explorer and see the full history. Every tax accepted every tax completed and every payment made. public permanent and nobody can touch this. no trust needed. the chain is the proof. So why avalanche? Why not any other chain? 3 reasons ? 1. Transaction conforms in under 5 second. any ai agent need that speed 2. Fees are near zero so your agent isn't lose money just to run 3. It works exactly like ethereum . same code same tools That's exactly why ava labs built the officialC-8004 boilerplate on avalanche So what exactly are we deploying today? 4 contracts total The Identity Registry & Reputation Registry are official shared contracts Already deployed by ewa labs on fujii Your agents just connect to them The validation registry & Tax Agent we deploy them Those are yours Your address and your agent. That Tax agent's address becomes your agent's permanent home on the blockchain. Total 5 Steps and we are done. Open vs code and terminal, clone the code from github, and, Install the dependencies, add your wallet private key and deploy it to avalanche Its simple, let me show you exactly how Open vs code, go to file, open folder, then select web3 folder Then open the terminol from the top menu That cursor in the bottom is where all commands go First command, this download the entire project straight from AvaLabs on your computer. Clone this repo and enter. When the prompt comes back, it's done. Now move to the project folder. Now to move into the project folder you have to type this and enter. Now install everything the project needs to run. So we need to install the npm, you will see a dot of text completely normal just wait two or three minutes then quickly install the back end as well. And npm install then enter so we are installing the backend. Then gd and double dot. Then enter. So, all installed, let's move on. Now let's connect the wallet. Create the setting file first. copy.env.example.env, then enter. Open the .env file from sidebar. You'll see a line that say private key, thats what we exactly to fill in. And important use a test wallet only. Zero real money in it. Private key is master key to your wallet. So anyone who has it owns it. So never share that with anyone so you have to download the called wallet extension in your PC and create the account and on the test and mode and to get the testnet tokens you have to visit the site then select the network the next select the token to receive and then you can connect your wallet here or you can type your address here. And for the coupon code, you can write Avalanche Academy. And from here you can request 2 AVEX Testnet tokens. Then you will receive the testnet token here. Now to have private key, go to Account. Then click options... And here Show Private key... And this is your private key. Copy this. Now go to vscode and in private key paste the wallet address but also remove the 0x from first and then save the file then go to the terminal and this is the moment one command npm run deploy fuji then enter it's compiling all the contracts first. Deployed validation registry is done. Tax agent is live. 1. 4 contact addresses all live on avalanche fuji right now and that tax agent address sitting permanently on blockchain and Let me actually prove this is real. Open the testnet.shorterest . . i o, then paste your tax agent address, contact address confirmation, transaction hash, proof it happened. My wallet, the deploier. And permanent, public, anyone can verify this. Look at what you just built. A verified on-chain agent identity, a public reputation system, a validation layer, all live on avalanche, five steps no code live on a blockchain. To catch up and review your mistakes you can use this video's link in description for details and other important sources. If you got stuck drop your errors in the comments. I will help you to fix it. I'm Lakshya and see you the next one.
